limitations: No hardware, implementation or simulation run.
All 340 snapshot sources match the fixed Git commit. 338 match release bytes directly; two review scripts match exactly after LF-to-CRLF conversion, with no content difference.
Only ZIP07 member and central-directory byte ranges fetched; full ZIP07 hash not rechecked.
ADF and sites PCF not downloaded/rehashed; published records bind their hashes.
Detailed RTR paths are selected by -max_path 128; 9110 is not all possible design paths.
484 external unconstrained reported paths; external I/O AC not signed off.
CDC is conservative Gray bound; native max-skew summary absent; not an exhaustive new CDC structural/MTBF signoff.
